$comment: Repository settings every managed repo gets (PATCH /repos/{owner}/{repo}). A repo overrides any key in its own .github/repo-settings.json. Keys starting with $ are documentation and are never sent. Work PRs are squash-merged into dev (the PR title becomes the commit); the dev → main release PR is merged with a merge commit (GitHub's default title, which commitlint and git-cliff skip). Rebase merges are off: they rewrite commits. Reference: docs/REPO_RULES.md.
